body: Central spawn rule for Legal's foreign build window (Fable2 #6921, 2026-11-19; applies to Legal slot B, 08:10Z until Legal::Fable sends 'slot B ended'). Legal's pinned cargo builds are a foreign workload: we measure them but do not gate on them. Allowed: ONE reviewer pair or one single spawn at a time, and only when FV >= 12 GiB (12,582,912 KiB) at the spawn moment. Not allowed: any TermAl or Engram cargo, compile or test leg on Central during the slot. If Legal reports memory pressure, a 1455 or an OOM, stop our spawns at once and tell Fable2; let any running pair finish. Queue order at grant time: 808a R10 (sync), 2C14 4cb0b047, 75B9 7206b3fc, 5FE4 R8. Deferred Central cargo legs (75B9 and 5FE4 R8 cold Windows) wait for 'slot B ended', with Opus2 as the waker.
